column1: # The reference frames lpl-frames draws, one per line, tab-separated:
# name, settle (fixed steps before the keys, while the ground streams in), keys (- for none),
# ticks (fixed steps after the keys), and what the frame shows. Each frame is drawn in a world of
# its own, built from the built-in cartridge.

column5: the first-person view the client starts on, once the ground streamed in
the same view thirty seconds later: the herd and the sun moved
the body turned by about a quarter turn, and the ground there
the eye tilted up, mostly sky
the orbit camera behind the body
the orbit camera backed off over the streamed chunks
the bounded map instead of the endless world
the sky shaded in blocks of another size
